title: Voice Account
description: A Voice Account is the central account for all things Voice related. Among others, phone numbers and SIP trunks will be linked to a certain Voice Account. **Please note** that a Voice Account is different from a Logical Account. You will be able to create multiple Voice Accounts with one Logical Account.

createdOn.description: Date and time on which the Voice Account was created.

guid.description: The unique identifier of the Voice Account.

name.description: The name of the Voice Account.

externalId.description: Optional external ID of the Voice Account that can be set by the customer for external references outside of the CM.com Platform.

externalName.description: Optional external name of the Voice Account that can be set by the customer for external references outside of the CM.com Platform.

apiKey.description:
The API key for authentication when making Voice application requests.
This will only be returned ONCE, please make sure to store it securely and handle it responsibly.

isActive.description: Whether or not the Voice Account is set to Active.

PrepaidInfo.title: Prepaid Info

amount.description: The amount of prepaid credit currently in the wallet.

PrepaidInfo.description: The prepaid credit of the Voice Account. Only returned if the the given Voice Account billing type is set to prepaid.
